mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the market value of the shares."
Premium value is the market value of the shares.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the forms of businesses permitted by law."
Partnership is one of the forms of businesses permitted by law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the price paid by an incoming partner in order to be admitted into the partnership."
A premium is the price paid by an incoming partner in order to be admitted into the partnership.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of such means to an end for the company."
Winding up by the court is one of such means to an end for the company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of equal number of directors and representatives of the shareholders."
The Audit committee is made up of equal number of directors and representatives of the shareholders.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the major organs of the company."
The two are the major organs of the company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a very important part of a company's existence."
Financial Statements are a very important part of a company's existence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a shareholder (member) of Aondongu Nig Ltd."
Aondohemba is a shareholder (member) of Aondongu Nig Ltd.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which a company's existence is terminated i.e. liquidated and subsequently dissolved and its assets sold off for the settlement of its creditors, members and employees."
Winding up is the process by which a company's existence is terminated i.e. liquidated and subsequently dissolved and its assets sold off for the settlement of its creditors, members and employees.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high-ranking officer of the company."
The company secretary is a high-ranking officer of the company.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the actual value at which the company issued or sold the shares."
The book value is the actual value at which the company issued or sold the shares.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the issuance/sale of shares by a company to realize its share capital."
Allotment is the issuance/sale of shares by a company to realize its share capital.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of the consensus of the aggregate partners and the partners are quite at liberty to stipulate the rules which regulate the business 'Which they have agreed to embark upon."

A partnership agreement is the result of the consensus of the aggregate partners and the partners are quite at liberty to stipulate the rules which regulate the business 'Which they have agreed to embark upon.
